claim.claim-text: 2. The catheter assembly (10, 200, 300) according to claim 1, wherein

the catheter operation member (20, 202, 302) includes a long portion (46, 212, 304) provided with the holding portion (58, 222, 308), and the long portion (46, 212, 304) can be curved in a direction separating away from the inner needle (16).
3. The catheter assembly (10, 200, 300) according to claim 2, wherein

the long portion (46, 212, 304) is engaged with the needle hub (18, 204, 310) in a manner relatively movable, and the needle hub (18, 204, 310) inhibits the long portion (46, 212, 304) from being curved in a state that the long portion (46, 212, 304) is engaged with the needle hub (18, 204, 310).

4. The catheter assembly (10, 300) according to claim 2, wherein the catheter (12) is detached from the holding portion (58, 308) against engagement force of the holding portion (58, 308) by curving the long portion (46, 304) in a direction away separating away from the inner needle (16).

5. The catheter assembly (10) according to claim 4, wherein the long portion (46) holds the catheter (12) with the holding portion (58) by being housed in the needle hub (18) in a manner formed in a linear shape in a width direction in front sectional view.

6. The catheter assembly (200) according to claim 2, wherein the catheter (12) is automatically detached from the holding portion (222) by curving the long portion (212) in a direction separating away from the inner needle (16).

7. The catheter assembly (200) according to claim 6, wherein the long portion (212) is configured to hold the catheter (12) with the holding portion (222) by being housed in the needle hub (204) in a manner formed in a mountain shape in a width direction in a front sectional view, and the catheter (12) is released from being held with the holding portion (222) by forming the long portion in a linear shape in a width direction as the long portion is curved in a direction separating away from the inner needle (16).

8. The catheter assembly (200) according to claim 7, wherein a planned curve portion (216) configured to induce the long portion (212) to be formed in a mountain shape in the width direction in a front sectional view is provided in a center portion in a width direction of the long portion (212).
9. The catheter assembly (10, 200, 300) according to claim 1, wherein a plurality of holding portions (58, 222, 308) is provided in an axial direction of the catheter (12).

10. The catheter assembly (200) according to claim 9, wherein the holding portion (222) is formed in a manner gradually becoming larger in a proximal end direction of the catheter operation member (202).
11. The catheter assembly (10, 200) according to claim 1, wherein the holding portion (58, 222) includes a pair of projecting portions (70, 224) to nip the catheter (12).
12. The catheter assembly (10) according to claim 11, wherein the pair of projecting portions (70) has phases deviated to each other in an axial direction of the catheter (12).
13. The catheter assembly (10) according to claim 11, wherein

the pair of projecting portions (70) includes nail portions (73, 74) projecting in directions coming close to each other and configured to hook and hold the catheter (12), and taper portions (73b, 74b) inclined inward in a width direction and toward a holding section are provided on an opposite side of the holding section for the catheter (12) in the nail portions (73, 74).

14. The catheter assembly (10, 200, 300) according to claim 1, wherein the catheter operation member (20, 202, 302) includes a hub attachment portion (48, 214, 305) attached to the catheter hub (14) and configured to transmit operation force of a user to the catheter hub (14).

15. The catheter assembly (200) according to claim 1, wherein the needle hub (204) includes a guide portion (210) configured to guide the catheter operation member (202) in a direction separating away from the inner needle (16) at the time of moving the catheter operation member (202) in a distal end direction.
